import random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as M

def naive_min(n,A,trans,accept):
    block=[1 if accept[s] else 0 for s in range(n)]
    changed=True
    while changed:
        changed=False
        sig={}
        newblock=[0]*n
        nxt=0
        for s in range(n):
            key=(block[s], tuple(block[trans[s][c]] for c in range(A)))
            if key not in sig:
                sig[key]=nxt; nxt+=1
            newblock[s]=sig[key]
        if newblock!=block:
            block=newblock; changed=True
    return block

random.seed(1)
for trial in range(3000):
    n=random.randint(1,9)
    A=random.randint(0,4)
    trans=[[random.randrange(n) for _ in range(A)] for _ in range(n)]
    accept=[random.random()<0.5 for _ in range(n)]
    blocks,block_of=M.hopcroft(n,A,trans,accept)
    nb=naive_min(n,A,trans,accept)
    if len(blocks)!=len(set(nb)):
        print("CLASS COUNT MISMATCH", trial,n,A,trans,accept)
        print("hopcroft classes",len(blocks),"naive",len(set(nb)))
        sys.exit(1)
    hp={}
    for s in range(n):
        hp.setdefault(block_of[s],set()).add(s)
    np={}
    for s in range(n):
        np.setdefault(nb[s],set()).add(s)
    if sorted([frozenset(v) for v in hp.values()])!=sorted([frozenset(v) for v in np.values()]):
        print("PARTITION MISMATCH",trial)
        sys.exit(1)
print("hopcroft matches naive on 3000 random DFAs")
